question: The National Mission on Natural Farming, which was launched in November 2024 aims to promote chemical-free farming among _______ crores farmers.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **National Mission on Natural Farming** was launched in **November 2024** by the Government of India. It focuses on promoting **chemical-free farming practices**.
 
• The mission aims to encourage natural farming techniques among **1 crore farmers** across India, reducing dependence on synthetic fertilizers and pesticides.
 
• Natural farming emphasizes the use of locally sourced, eco-friendly inputs like **cow dung, cow urine, and bio-compost** to enhance soil fertility and sustainability.
 
• This initiative is part of India's broader commitment to achieving **sustainable agricultural practices** and reducing the harmful environmental impacts of chemical farming.
